purpose: Official source coverage audit only; these Eurostat samples are not model training data.
coverage_note: APRO_CPSHR has 79 crop categories. Lentils and chickpeas are only pooled in P9000 with other pulses; tomato is not a separate regional category. Direct regional yield values for ES61 are absent; production and area are observed separately. A production/area ratio would need its source area basis checked.
model_data_choice: MAPA provincial annual crop tables were selected for exact crop identity instead.
mask_note: SAGE calendars do not separate chickpea/lentil/faba or contain tomato; broad pulses calendars cannot replace crop calendars. JRC EUCROPMAP does not separate those pulses and sorghum; ITACyL distinguishes chickpea/lentil in newer Castilla y Leon maps, but not all ten crops consistently across Spain/years. No generic mask was relabelled as crop-specific.
